title: Purpose map
intro: GlassCam's screens, capture modes, camera-screen controls, gallery buttons and settings, by what they are for. Drafted 2026-10-20 to find redundancy: the six purposes (set E6) were scored against eight reference camera apps (coverage, exclusivity, balance, GlassCam fit, potential improvement) and chosen by the owner after a mock-up; the granularity (G4) lists every control, and settings rows by section except the rows in a redundancy-candidate pair. `refs` names the reference apps that do the same job; `overlaps` names the map entries it is a redundancy candidate with. 4.3.95 built the owner's decisions on the candidates (docs/purpose/findings-2026-10-20.md): one histogram button, flash set on the Flash toggle only, one MFNR row, one Save camera info row, edge sharpening explained; three rows that could never show were removed.

purposes.name: Frame and shoot
purposes.job: see the scene, pick the lens and the mode, and take the picture

purposes.name: Control exposure and focus
purposes.job: get brightness and sharpness right - by hand, or by steering the automatics - and see whether they are right

purposes.name: Shape the image
purposes.job: colour, processing, and the file that comes out

purposes.name: Sequences and video
purposes.job: many frames for one result, frames over time, and video with its sound

purposes.name: Review and keep
purposes.job: look at what was taken, keep it where I want it, and what the file says about it

purposes.name: Make it work on this phone
purposes.job: the camera API, phone-specific workarounds, and how the app itself behaves

screens.name: Camera screen
screens.does: The main camera screen: live preview, shutter, controls and settings.

screens.name: Camera from the lock screen
screens.does: Opens the camera from the lock screen without unlocking the phone.

screens.name: Take a photo for another app
screens.does: Lets another app ask GlassCam to take a photo and hands the result back.

screens.name: GlassGallery
screens.does: Gallery to browse, view and delete the photos and videos taken.

screens.name: Raw to DNG converter
screens.does: Converts raw files into DNG files the person can edit.

screens.name: DNG stacker
screens.does: Merges several DNG frames into one stacked DNG.

screens.name: Video profile editor
screens.does: Screen to create and edit custom video profiles (resolution, fps, bitrate, codec).

screens.name: Photo mode
screens.does: Normal photo mode.

screens.name: Video mode
screens.does: Video recording mode.

screens.name: Interval mode
screens.does: Interval/timelapse mode: takes a photo every set number of seconds.

screens.name: Exposure bracketing mode
screens.does: Exposure bracketing mode: several shots at different exposures in one press.

screens.name: Exposure bracketing mode (Huawei)
screens.does: Exposure bracketing mode using Huawei's own bracketing support.

screens.name: Focus bracketing mode
screens.does: Focus bracketing mode: several shots at different focus distances, for focus stacking.

screens.name: Photo mode (MediaTek)
screens.does: Photo mode for MediaTek phones, including their raw capture path.

screens.name: Photo mode
screens.does: Normal photo mode on the older camera API.

screens.name: Interval mode
screens.does: Interval/timelapse mode on the older camera API.

screens.name: Video mode (LG)
screens.does: Video mode for LG phones using LG's own recorder.

screens.name: Video mode
screens.does: Video recording mode on the older camera API.

screens.name: Exposure bracketing mode
screens.does: Exposure bracketing mode on the older camera API.

screens.name: Camera switch
screens.does: Switches between the back and front camera (and other cameras).

screens.name: Self-timer
screens.does: Sets a countdown before the photo is taken.

screens.name: Histogram
screens.does: Shows a live histogram of brightness on the preview. Since 4.3.95 shown only on phones without the hardware histogram.

screens.name: Focus peaking
screens.does: Highlights the sharp parts of the preview (focus peaking).

screens.name: Clipping (zebras)
screens.does: Marks over- and under-exposed areas on the preview (zebras).

screens.name: Histogram (camera hardware)
screens.does: Shows a histogram computed by the camera hardware itself. Since 4.3.95 the only histogram button on phones that have it.

screens.name: Tone curve
screens.does: Opens a tone curve to shape contrast and brightness of the image.

screens.name: Focus mode
screens.does: Chooses the focus mode (auto, continuous, macro, manual, ...).

screens.name: Capture mode switch
screens.does: Switches capture mode (photo, video, interval, bracketing...).

screens.name: Exposure lock (AEL)
screens.does: Locks the automatic exposure so it stops changing.

screens.name: Flash
screens.does: Sets the flash: off, auto, always, torch, and auto with red-eye pre-flash. Since 4.3.95 the only place to set flash.

screens.name: Zoom
screens.does: Zooms in and out.

screens.name: Manual focus
screens.does: Sets focus distance by hand.

screens.name: ISO
screens.does: Sets ISO (sensor sensitivity) by hand.

screens.name: Shutter speed
screens.does: Sets shutter speed by hand.

screens.name: Exposure compensation (EV)
screens.does: Makes the automatic exposure brighter or darker (EV).

screens.name: Aperture
screens.does: Sets the lens aperture on phones with a variable aperture.

screens.name: White balance (Kelvin)
screens.does: Sets white balance colour temperature by hand (Kelvin).

screens.name: Burst
screens.does: Sets how many photos one shutter press takes (burst).

screens.name: Contrast
screens.does: Sets image contrast.

screens.name: Brightness
screens.does: Sets image brightness.

screens.name: Saturation
screens.does: Sets colour saturation.

screens.name: Sharpness
screens.does: Sets image sharpening.

screens.name: Zebra high level
screens.does: Sets the brightness level above which zebras mark highlights as clipped.

screens.name: Zebra low level
screens.does: Sets the brightness level below which zebras mark shadows as clipped.

screens.name: setting:TIMELAPSE_FRAMES
screens.does: Sets the playback frame rate of the assembled timelapse video.

screens.name: Video HDR
screens.does: Turns on HDR video recording.

screens.name: Video Stabilization
screens.does: Turns video stabilisation on or off.

screens.name: Size
screens.does: Sets the photo resolution.

screens.name: YUV size
screens.does: Sets the size of the YUV image stream used for capture.

screens.name: Physical Camera
screens.does: Pins capture to one physical lens instead of letting the phone switch automatically.

screens.name: MNFR
screens.does: Merges several frames to reduce noise (multi-frame noise reduction). One row since 4.3.95: Xiaomi's key stands in where Qualcomm's is missing.

screens.name: Shutter fire interval
screens.does: Sets the time between shots in interval mode.

screens.name: CustomMatrix
screens.does: Picks a custom colour matrix (DNG profile) for raw files.

screens.name: ToneMapProfile
screens.does: Picks the tone curve profile written into DNG files.

screens.name: Use GlassCam DngConverter
screens.does: Uses GlassCam's own DNG converter for 16-bit raw.

screens.name: Use custom DNG profile
screens.does: Uses the chosen custom DNG colour profile under Camera2.

screens.name: Raw size
screens.does: Sets the raw image resolution.

screens.name: Save camera info
screens.does: Writes this camera's parameters (Camera1) or vendor keys (Camera2) to a text file, for bug reports. One row for both APIs since 4.3.95 (was Save Camera Parameters + Dump vendor keys).

screens.name: Swap preview width and height
screens.does: Swaps preview width and height when the preview looks stretched.

screens.name: Force Wide Preview
screens.does: Uses the widest available preview size.

screens.name: Scene
screens.does: Picks a scene preset (night, sports, portrait...).

screens.name: WB
screens.does: Picks a white balance preset (auto, daylight, cloudy...).

screens.name: Color Effect
screens.does: Applies a colour effect (mono, sepia, negative...).

screens.name: Tonemap
screens.does: Sets how the camera maps tones (contrast curve mode).

screens.name: Camera Control
screens.does: Turns the camera's automatic controls (exposure, focus, white balance) on or off.

screens.name: Red-Eye Reduction
screens.does: Fires a pre-flash to reduce red eye.

screens.name: Noise reduction
screens.does: Sets noise reduction for photos.

screens.name: Temporal Denoise
screens.does: Multi-frame temporal noise reduction for photos.

screens.name: Virtual Lens Filter
screens.does: Applies a virtual lens filter effect.

screens.name: Digital Image Stabilization
screens.does: Electronic image stabilisation.

screens.name: HDR Mode
screens.does: Turns the camera's built-in HDR on or off.

screens.name: Correlated double sampling
screens.does: Correlated double sampling: reads the sensor twice to reduce noise.

screens.name: Edge sharpening (camera)
screens.does: Sets edge enhancement (sharpening).

screens.name: Optical Image Stabilisation
screens.does: Turns optical image stabilisation on or off.

screens.name: Dual Camera
screens.does: Chooses which sensor(s) of a dual camera to use.

screens.name: Auto Exposure Mode
screens.does: Turns the camera's automatic exposure on or off (its flash variants moved to the Flash toggle in 4.3.95).

screens.name: AE Meter Area
screens.does: Chooses the area used to measure exposure.

screens.name: Photo info (EXIF)
screens.does: Shows the photo's details (EXIF information).

screens.name: Back to the grid
screens.does: Closes the full-screen view and returns to the gallery.

screens.name: Play video
screens.does: Plays the selected video.

screens.name: Delete
screens.does: Deletes the shown file.
